claims.text: Findlay, Missouri S&T and Cal State Monterey Bay lose at last Findlay, Missouri S&T and Cal State Monterey Bay had each won four from four. All lost on the same day, Findlay at Kentucky Wesleyan, Missouri S&T at Quincy and Monterey Bay at Point Loma, and Lee, Shippensburg, Westminster and Georgian Court lost unbeaten starts of their own.
